description: The file Src/Parser.php defines a class 'Parser' responsible for parsing SCSS/Sass syntax into an internal representation, including handling of directives, rules, media queries, functions, and other CSS/Sass constructs. It appears to be part of the 'scssphp' library, a PHP implementation for parsing and compiling SCSS files.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Main parser class for handling SCSS/Sass source code, providing methods for parsing entire stylesheets, value lists, selectors, media queries, and directives, utilizing a recursive descent parsing strategy.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the source file being parsed.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main entry point for parsing a complete SCSS/Sass source buffer into an internal block representation, with caching support.

methods.name: parseValue
methods.description: Parses a value or list of values from the input buffer.

methods.name: parseSelector
methods.description: Parses a selector or selector list from the input buffer.

methods.name: parseChunk
methods.description: Parses a single component (directive, rule, media query, etc.) from the buffer; used repeatedly within 'parse'.

methods.name: pushBlock
methods.description: Creates and pushes a new block (rule set, at-rule, etc.) onto the parse tree.

methods.name: popBlock
methods.description: Pops the last block (scope) from the parse tree, finalizing its content.
